org_name.title: org_name
org_name.description: Organization or app name that is displayed to the user.

allocation.title: allocation
allocation.description: Allocation specified for the link token.

skip_intro_screen.title: skip_intro_screen
skip_intro_screen.description: If set to true, intro screen is not shown to user.

employer_id.title: employer_id
employer_id.description: UUID of an employer. If set, user is taken directly to Link login screen.

disable_direct_deposit_splitting.title: disable_direct_deposit_splitting
disable_direct_deposit_splitting.description: If set to true, user will not be given the option to choose between a full or partial direct deposit switch. Only relevant with job `direct_deposit_switch`. Defaults to false.

platform_id.title: platform_id
platform_id.description: UUID of a platform. If set, user is taken directly to Link login screen.

platform_type.description: The type of the platform. `payroll` platforms are used for direct-deposit switching and for Verify use cases. `time_and_attendance` platforms contain data around shifts and hours. `tax` platforms are used for tax solutions. `merchant` type platforms are used for bill switching and cancellation.

language.description: IETF code denoting which language to display in Link.

end_user_id.title: end_user_id
end_user_id.description: User ID provided by you, to associate Pinwheel users with your user model. Required if `account_id` is not provided. This ID will be returned in all webhook events and all account-affiliated API responses. Leading and trailing whitespace will be stripped. Do not include PII in this identifier.

document_uploads.description: Optional parameter to facilitate pathway into document uploads usage. Defaults to None.

tags.title: tags
tags.description: Tags associated with the Link token. These are restricted to string key-value pairs.

deposit_forms.description: Optional parameter to facilitate pathway into deposit forms. Defaults to fallback if deposit forms are enabled for your workspace.

use_case.description: Field to indicate where in your application Pinwheel is being launched. Required if leveraging Background Identify (PreMatch employee lookup check prior to SDK initialization).

end_user.title: end_user
end_user.description: Optional field where data about an end user can be provided to enable products such as automated platform matching.

cards.title: cards
cards.description: Card details needed to attempt a bill switch.

reseller_customer_id.title: reseller_customer_id
reseller_customer_id.description: The identifier for a reseller's customer. This field is required for resellers. For other customers, a non-null value will result in a 400 error. The value supplied must be preregistered with Pinwheel's customer success team.

solution.description: The Pinwheel solution to be presented to the user.

features.description: A list of job types to be performed on the user's account. Platforms/merchants that do not support ALL of these jobs will not be visible to the user. This property is required unless the account_id property is set.
